# Entered in error

medrec's own fixture for what its source says is entered in error, from medrec-cli 0.9.9's `tests/fixtures/errors`: one invented person's records. `index.json`, `marks.json` and `overrides.json` are byte for byte medrec-cli's.

`views/` is all that `medrec views write` wrote for the folder (`scripts/own-folder.mjs`, with the household of `../words`). `node scripts/derived.mjs`, with medrec on `PATH`, rebuilds it. Every value is invented.
